basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Reproduces a same-currency total exactly from the original inputs under an explicit rounding policy.
Keeps rounding residuals as records even when they cancel out.
Refuses mixed-currency arithmetic and never fetches or chooses an exchange rate.

may: Validate monetary inputs and replay a total per item or after sum.
Request a missing value or rounding policy from its owner.
mustNot: Replace an unknown amount with zero.
Use floating point, exponents or signed zero for money.
Select or fetch an exchange rate.
Overwrite an original input when correcting.
requiresHuman: Choosing a rounding policy where none is declared.
Accepting a correction that changes a reported total.

considerations: Rounding errors across many transactions can quietly move money between parties.
Exact reproducibility protects customers and staff in disputes about amounts.
affectedParties: Customers and suppliers paying or receiving amounts

owners.steward: The finance function owns rounding policies; amounts stay owned by the system that issued them.

items: Source slot IDs for each input amount.

properties.reason: Institutional or informational subject: it has no physical body to measure.

items: A calculation record lists exact decimal inputs in one currency, the rounding policy, the total and residuals.
Silent loss through binary floating point.
Wrong totals from implicit currency conversion.
ISO 4217 currency codes and minor units.
Invoicing, pricing and reporting where totals must be reproducible.

sections.whatItIs: A companion contract for a Company Dimension that keeps exact decimal money inputs in one currency and reproduces their total under an explicit rounding policy, with residuals and immutable correction evidence.

sources.title: Research record EM-XCT-06: independent provider studies, audits and reconciled findings
sources.note: Evidence behind the release; claims in the card trace to it.
